provenance_chain.verified_by: experiment_cli validate; freeze-commit precedes runs (git chronology)
distinctness check per protocol; collision -> technical classification
materialize from git cat-file blob + digest check before each run

provenance_chain.recorded_in: manifest.json#model/#environment (binary_sha256, size, build flags, upstream commit)
provenance_chain.verified_by: sha256/size/flags verified before each run; rebuild -> new SHA in new subject
experiment_cli validate + experiment_cli verify-digests + O1 storage_location lint
S003 rule: SUPPORTED only on analysis surface with verification surface

stop_resume.stop_recording: terminal event (RUN_ABORTED | RUN_FAILED_TECHNICAL | RUN_BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT) with cause, consumed resources, partial artifact refs
stop_resume.resume_recording: new run with new run_id; RESUMED marker on a RUN_CHECKPOINT event of the new run

constraints: interrupted run must already carry its terminal event before the resume run is published
reuse_scope values reference digests of the source run (raw artifact reuse requires digest + provenance)
resume point is a checkpoint boundary unless the protocol defines otherwise
resumed_marker_convention.mechanical_enforcement: convention (grep surface) in R1; automated check is a future candidate

deduplication.rule: identical frozen surface is never re-executed; evidence references the existing run

decisions.all_links_identical: reference existing run (counts_toward_evidence + provenance note); no new run
decisions.inputs_binaries_or_protocol_differ: new run id + superseding subject/protocol revision
decisions.technical_failure: new run id with recorded cause; authorized retry only under a new id

precedents: E1-R1-S001 reused in E1-R2 confirmatory set (counts_toward_evidence=true)

readback.source_of_truth: git blobs (git cat-file blob <rev>:<path>), never the working copy (autocrlf lesson, VERIFIER NL2-001 §3 / NL2-002 F-3)
readback.digest_rule: raw artifact reuse requires sha256/size from artifacts.manifest.json (hard rule)
readback.chronology: commit dates + per-event machine timestamps; placeholder timestamps rejected by work_cli/experiment_cli

validator_hardening_r1.S003: scientific_outcome=SUPPORTED is rejected on non-analysis surfaces; ANALYSIS_COMPLETED requires non-empty artifact_refs resolving to existing artifacts
validator_hardening_r1.O1: in-Git storage_location (experiments/ prefix) must contain manifest campaign_id and run_id as path segments
validator_hardening_r1.O2_F3: midnight placeholder, unparseable/missing timestamp_utc, and constant copy stamps across >=3 events (legacy exact-whitelist) are errors; rationale: warnings are not gating (POS001 signature is 0 warnings) and placeholders defeat chronology reconstruction
validator_hardening_r1.emit_run_order: artifacts.manifest.json is serialized after the final case_record.json write; digest-invariance of schema validation is asserted (REPAIR_MAP_F1_R1 §5.1)

non_goals: new v1 event types (RESUMED stays a RUN_CHECKPOINT convention)
retroactive edits to published batch-timestamp events (immutable; exact whitelist only)
